body.objective: Construct or exactly obstruct the minimal temporal Maxwell/emitter antifield covariance representation required to remove the certified Berger arity-two quotient class before any quartic, redshift or detector promotion is retried.
body.stop_condition: Import BERGER_DIRECT_TEMPORAL_AK_DIFF_COVARIANCE_REPAIR from commit 0e1e26d48 by exact certificate and payload hashes. Begin from its complete 934-column-per-emitter ambient action module and its quotient witness A_plus_0 <- (tau,e0 e1 K0_01) = -3 g0 h0. Declare the smallest new field/ghost/antifield representation whose q1 image can reach that coordinate and all Diff, Weyl, Maxwell, emitter and cyclic descendants forced by closure; derive it from one local action rather than inserting a q2 coefficient. Solve the enlarged q1 nilpotency, real structure, odd pairing, action Hessian and complete arity-two coderivation identities exactly. Recompute the full covariance image and quotient for both emitters. If the quotient closes, export the unique or complete moduli family of admissible q2 repairs and the strict input needed to replay q3, K_Berger and relational observables. If it does not, certify the first surviving quotient class in a completeness-declared enlargement. Include independent action-variation and rank/cokernel rails plus mutations omitting each forced descendant.
body.current_gate: minimal action-derived temporal Maxwell/emitter antifield module that closes the exact arity-two covariance quotient
body.forbid: no isolated q2 coefficient added without a local action and cotangent lift; no direct temporal tau-star repair substituted for the full tau-star/A-plus covariance projection; no inherited Diff normalization freed as physical data; no q3 or quartic term used to repair an arity-two identity; no K_Berger, detector, redshift, memory, recoil, tangent-cone, branch or quantum claim before the enlarged arity-two locus is nonempty
activates: a justified replay of the common-action quartic and relational-redshift gate
or a stronger representation-complete nonlinear observer obstruction
a reusable Maxwell/emitter antifield module for the complex-compensator observer theory
body.resource_hint: DIRECT SUCCESSOR to the exact -3 g0 h0 quotient obstruction. Work at arity two first. A complete-module obstruction is a successful terminal result and must precede any renewed quartic/redshift work.
notes: The previous direct temporal A-K projection was repairable; the obstruction lives in the joint Maxwell-cotangent covariance projection.
The old quartic/redshift and branch-atlas fallbacks cannot promote a same-action observable until this module exists.
The construction should be reusable later in the complex compensator-clock theory, but no cross-theory identification is assumed.
